mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen countertop installation is influenced by several factors, including the material type (e.g., laminate is less expensive than granite), the total square footage required, the complexity of the cuts and edge profiles, and any need for sink or cooktop cutouts. Additional costs can arise from removing old countertops or special considerations for accessibility or structural modifications. Obtaining a detailed estimate that outlines all these components is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include material type, square footage, cut complexity, edge profiles, and cutouts for sinks or cooktops. Old countertop removal can also add to the cost.
